text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa……
All signal traces of "Pursuers"――lost.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe desires recognition.
How will you――"interact" with 『Me』?

Unsure what she sought,
but wanted Neo Universe to understand me.
choice_data_list: Who are you, and what do you want to do?
Who are you, and what do you want to do?

text_block_list.text:
Needed baseline clarity to help.
Even if identity remained veiled, wanted her goal.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
What do I……desire……?
Neo Universe seeks――to "actualize".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Requirement: self-comprehension……then――"emulate"?

……Seemed to have an objective, but meaning escaped me.
Difficult concept to verbalize?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: First, request――"dialogue" with you.

Understood that much.
Neo Universe sought mutual connection.

Meaning……mutual understanding was step one.
Took her off-campus to unfamiliar spots.
First stop: ramen shop.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Ton・kotsu……raamen……raaamen……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Classification: 『Food』.
Zero prior intake, but……

Concept of food registered with her.
Basics cleared, next up was……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Is this……a "Sanctuary"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Observation facility――diverse biological entities――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Perceiving 『Cute』 induces euphoria in Neo Universe……Translation: 『Excited』.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. ――[Like].

Gradual mutual understanding taking root.
Faint smile appeared on her face.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Today……experienced 『Fun』.

Progress beat expectations.
Her phrasing grew clearer, opening up next step……

Might get clearer answers
on her identity and goals.
Excuse me, Uni-san? You're Uni-san, right!
Another Uma Musume ran up to us.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Knew it! Caught your run earlier.
It's me, Zenno Rob Roy. From the library.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zenno……Rob Roy……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Entity recognized as "familiar".
Appears I am in your debt.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
After all, Uni-san is……

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A student of Tracen Academy, after all!

First concrete intel on this cryptic girl.
Neo Universe was an enrolled Tracen student……
choice_data_list: I've never seen her wearing the uniform……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Uniform……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Also……in my "possession"……

Confirmed by her reaction.
In the end, Neo Universe was an ordinary Tracen student……

No, far from ordinary. Demeanor was too eccentric.
What kind of Uma Musume was she?
choice_data_list: Rob Roy, do you know anything about her?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
About Uni-san?
Well, Uni-san is……

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A bit mysterious……Uses difficult vocabulary……
so in class, she often ends up solitary.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: But…… I have spoken with her several times. I am on library duty, and Uni-san often visits the library.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uni-san…… umm. We have talked often, but today was the first time I saw your run. How should I put it……?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It was a…… magnificent run! A different kind of gallantry from the heroes in my books, but filled with such profound presence……!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Especially…… that final stretch spurt! Slipping through that tight gap without hesitation. It felt almost like you vanished……!
It felt like she vanished. Meaning, as expected, she did not literally vanish into thin air. Which means……
Neo Universe was simply an Uma Musume with a somewhat eccentric way of speaking. I had let my imagination run wild.
Still, questions remained. What did Neo Universe truly seek? And above all――
That night on the roof. If she had not dropped from the sky, how did she get onto a locked rooftop in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, is something the matter?
choice_data_list: There was one thing I was curious about……
There was one thing I was curious about……

text_block_list.text: Perhaps this matter was best discussed alone with her.
choice_data_list: Neo Universe, can you come with me?
Neo Universe, can you come with me?

text_block_list.text: Parting with Zenno Rob Roy, we headed toward that place.
――The rooftop at night. The place where first contact was made with Neo Universe.
How did you reach this rooftop that night, Neo Universe?
choice_data_list: The door should have been locked……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ……"MUTX".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
……It was "MUTX".
Neo Universe's…… initial……
Another fragmented word. Yet somehow, the pieces connected. Perhaps back then, Neo Universe had――
It made sense. Even if Neo Universe lacked a key herself, someone with access could have opened it.
Yes, someone like――
